name: LSeg Teacher Network for Feature Distillation
definition: Use of 2D vision(-and-language) models, specifically LSeg, as teacher networks for distilling features into NeRF, leveraging pretrained CLIP models as text and image feature encoders.
summary: LSeg Teacher Network distills 2D vision-language features into 3D representations, offering pixel-level semantic supervision that enables localized editing and segmentation, unlike global embedding approaches.
